text_block_list.text: The Senior Year has arrived. Last year I attended the Duramente clan's New Year's party, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

At Duramente's request, we began training
early in the morning this year.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright.
Looking good."
choice_data_list: Duramente has made a complete comeback!
Duramente's made a complete comeback, hasn't she!

text_block_list.text:
The doctor gave me a clean bill of health regarding my bones.
My body is in even better shape than it was before the Japanese Derby... no, better than ever.
choice_data_list: I can get even stronger this year
We can get even stronger this year, can't we?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Looking back now, perhaps having
that grace period last year was a good thing."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Both you and I...
have grown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This year, without fail,
I will challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—and win.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Dura-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: C-Congratulations...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
Are you two out training as well?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Total coincidence! We just happened to meet
Cheval-chan at the school gates!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Kita-san's pace was so fast...
It was really tough to keep up...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...You say that,
but you're not out of breath at all."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That's proof of her stamina.
She's been in great shape in recent races, too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You're growing, too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...'Lately'?
Even though I haven't been able to run in any GⅠ races at all..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I, um... unlike everyone else,
I haven't run... in the Classic Triple Crown, after all."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I haven't achieved any big results...
So I at least need to show some growth...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm really looking forward
to running with you now that you've gotten stronger, Cheval-chan!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Everyone in our generation is super cool, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're like that too, Dura-san!
...So bright it's almost blinding!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If I can compete with all of them
and run a great race... it'll be the best festival ever!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run a race that fires everyone up
alongside my greatest rivals!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Talking about rivals?
Then please let me join in!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Crown.
Are you training too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Correct! As soon as you left the room,
I scrambled to get everything ready.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
I tried to be careful, but did I wake you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
I was planning to go for a run either way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...I experienced some terrible results last year.
I have to become stronger myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to anyone here!
Until everything is over, who is number one among our generation...
is still yet to be decided!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, once we enter a race,
we are rivals competing against each other.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The Classic races are only against those of the same generation.
I understand viewing them as rivals, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: This year, you'll be facing the Senior Class and the younger generation too. It'll be the same for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "...Are you asking why I view those of my own generation as special rivals?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eh,
I never even thought about that!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Because... aren't those from the same generation supposed to be your biggest rivals forever?!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Exactly, Kitasan.
In this case, Duramente is the one who doesn't understand.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"We competed for the exact same crown.
—Of course you're the one person I refuse to lose to!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't know.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I have a true and proper understanding
of everyone's running.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yet, what slumbered within it...
I never knew the sheer passion that everyone held.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Just like me,
everyone has their own "feelings" inside them.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: Someone will carry on those feelings

text_block_list.text:
"Someday, someone carrying on their will
might compete just as they do now.
In fact, strange twists of fate like that have happened before."
choice_data_list: Maybe we'll all still be competing together in the future.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"If such a future truly awaits...
I must admit, I'd like to catch a small glimpse of it."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...We've finished the scheduled training,
so what should we do after this?"
Next up is—
choice_data_list: I'm going to have you take it easy and rest.
Pray for improvement in one's craft

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
True. Normally, I'd want to put in
some extra training right about now, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let your body rest well.
...That's important too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (...I said that, but rest, huh... How do I even do that?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Duramente-san!
Thank you for earlier.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of going to take a short break after this...
Would you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I see, a thermal bath facility.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Relaxing, isn't it?
This is my favorite spot.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The outdoor reclining bath feels amazing!
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
――...See?
Isn't it the best?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Duramente-san?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Fast asleep—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good.
I've only done light cardio so far anyway...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let's just call that a warm-up.
Now, to the gym.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: What should we start with? Upper body... or lower body?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Should I stick to the basics and start with the quadriceps...
No, maybe mix it up a bit and go from the deltoids?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Because of family gatherings over the New Year, I couldn't come every day.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I want to train multiple muscle groups today.
I'm counting on you.

It is said the deity of artistic mastery
grants wishes such as wanting to hone
one's racing techniques...
choice_data_list: It seems that shrine is nearby.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we give it a go?
(Clap, clap!)
choice_data_list: (I hope Dura's arts and crafts improve.)

text_block_list.text:
After finishing our shrine visit and taking a brief stroll...
Duramente suddenly came to a halt.
Her eyes were fixed upon—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, it seems many people
are painting pictures here."
choice_data_list: You might be curious about Dura's drawings too

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
Then... I guess I'll give it a try.

And so, Duramente and I
tried writing an ema—

"I want to grow like a mighty tree."
Next to those words was a nicely drawn picture of a tree.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I love trees.
I can draw them without even looking.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Think so?
I based it on the tree Big Sis Groove planted.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's magnificent.
I'm glad I was able to express it.
